```{r}
library(DT)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
# The catalogue comes from the owdata harvest, which reads every repository in
# the organisation once a week. Until washr 1.1.0 this page read a Google Sheet
# that nothing writes to any more (openwashdata/owdata#11).
owd_base <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openwashdata/owdata/main/inst/extdata/"

packages <- readr::read_csv(paste0(owd_base, "owd_packages.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Data

Every R data package in the openwashdata organisation. Each one comes with its
own website and documentation, so the data can be reused and cited. A package
with a DOI is deposited on Zenodo, which is what makes it permanently archived
and citable.

:::{.column-page}
```{r}
# DT renders HTML, not markdown, so the links are written as anchors. The
# previous version of this page passed markdown and the links came out as
# literal text.
link <- function(text, href) {
  paste0('<a href="', href, '">', text, '</a>')
}

tbl <- packages |>
  mutate(
    Package = link(pkg_name, url_docs),
    Description = description,
    DOI = ifelse(is.na(doi), "", link("DOI", paste0("https://doi.org/", doi))),
    Updated = format(date, "%d %b %Y")
  ) |>
  select(Package, Description, Datasets = n_datasets, DOI, Updated) |>
  arrange(Package)

datatable(
  tbl,
  escape = FALSE,
  rownames = FALSE,
  class = "compact stripe hover",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 25,
    lengthMenu = c(10, 25, 50, 100),
    autoWidth = FALSE,
    columnDefs = list(
      # Descriptions run to several sentences. Truncate them and keep the full
      # text in the title attribute, so the row stays one or two lines.
      list(
        targets = 1,
        render = JS(
          "function(data, type, row) {",
          "  if (type !== 'display' || data === null) return data;",
          "  var cut = 150;",
          "  if (data.length <= cut) return data;",
          "  return '<span title=\"' + data.replace(/\"/g, '&quot;') + '\">' +",
          "         data.substr(0, cut) + '…</span>';",
          "}"
        )
      ),
      list(targets = c(2, 3), className = "dt-center"),
      list(targets = 4, className = "dt-nowrap")
    )
  )
)
```
:::
